  MANIPAL ACADEMY OF HIGHER EDUCATION  
  MIT BLR - BTech VI Semester Makeup Examination, June -2025  
  SYSTEM ON CHIP [ECE-3222]  
  Marks: 50                                                                                 Duration: 180 mins.  
  PART-A  
  Answer all the questions.  
  1)           Assume you are in a company that will market a certain IC chip. The fixed costs,  
  including R&D, fabrication and equipment, and so on, add up to \$500,000. The cost per  
  wafer is \$6000, and each wafer can be diced into 1500 dies. The die yield is 50%.  
  A)      Finally, the dies are packaged and tested, at a cost of \$10 per chip. The test yield is 90%; (5)  
  only those that pass the test will be sold to customers. If the retail price is 40% more  
  than the cost, at least how many chips must be sold to break even?  
  
  B)      Design a mealy finite sate machine for serial addition with a neat diagram.                 (3)  
  C)      What are the different trade-offs considered while designing a SoC?                         (2)  
  2)           Design a Datapath for dividing two numbers input by the user, using adder/subtraction,  
  comparator units. Identify the high-level state diagram for the machine.  
  (5)  
  A)  
  B)      What are the different constituent units of SoC?                                            (3)  
  C)      Explain Snoopy and MESI cache protocols with a neat diagram.                                (2)  
  3)           Consider a pipeline having 4 phases with duration 60,50,90 and 80ns. Given latch delay  
  as 10ns. Calculate:  
  a) Pipeline cycle time  
  A)      b) Non -pipeline execution time  
  c) Speed up ratio                                                                      (4)  
  d) Pipeline time for 1000 tasks  
  e) Sequential time for 1000 tasks  
  f) Throughput  
  
  B)      Use K-mean algorithm to cluster the following 7 examples into 2 clusters: A1= (183,72),  
  $$A2= (171,58), A3= (174,64), A4= (177,68), A5=(184,74), A6=(186,79),A7=(184,75).         (4)$$  
  
  C)      Explain the data transfer in 2-D mesh of NoC.                                               (2)  
  4)           What is arbitration? Explain different types of bus arbitration protocols.  
  (5)  
  A)
